data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root word 'Ras' which means 'head' or 'chief'. This name symbolizes grace, nobility, and eloquence. historical_references.reference: Rasyad was a prominent Malay ruler who reigned over the Malacca Sultanate in the late 15th century. He is best known for his successful defense against Portuguese attempts to conquer Malacca.

Rasyad was also a prominent scholar and patron of Islamic learning in the Middle East during the 13th century. He was a major supporter of the Ash'ari theological school and wrote several influential works on Islamic jurisprudence and theology.
